svg.title: All three terms on an illustrative sphere
svg.desc: A mathematical illustration, not a capture of the course cube. The sphere has radius 0.9, center (0,0,-3), constant linear albedo (0.55,0.28,0.12), and white tint. Eye (0,0,0), light (2,2,0), and the chapter’s coefficients 0.16, 0.84, 0.35 and exponent 32 are shared by all four panels. This panel shows the sum of the three contributions in linear light. All panels use the same exposure, clamping and linear-to-sRGB conversion.
